card.statement:
[Analogous to {<<cite:BBL>>}]
The irreducible highest weight $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_{n+1})$-module $L(\lambda)$ is completely pointed only if $\lambda=\pm 1,\lambda_i=\pm q,\lambda_1=c,\lambda_n=c$, $\lambda_i\lambda_{i+1}=\pm q^{-1}$ for some $i=1,2,\dots, n-1$, where $c\in \mathbb{F^\times}$ is arbitrary and all unspecified entries are $\pm 1$.
card.label: Proposition 2

paper.title: Irreducible completely pointed modules of quantum groups of type $A$
paper.abstract: We give a classification of all irreducible completely pointed $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_{n+1})$ modules over a characteristic zero field in which $q$ is not a root of unity. This generalizes the classification result of Benkart, Britten and Lemire in the non quantum case. We also show that any infinite-dimensional irreducible completely pointed $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_{n+1})$ can be obtained from some irreducible completely pointed module over the quantized Weyl algebra $A_{n+1}^q$.
